claims.text: Phrasal compositionality is scored using a context-dependent model that computes the likelihood of surrounding context words given a phrase representation.
The scoring model evaluates phrases based on their predictive power regarding context words, indicating whether they are used in a compositional or non-compositional manner.
The approach requires only shallow syntactic parsing, making it less reliant on complex resources compared to other models.
